title: IDEA special education - federal basics
facts: The Individuals with Disabilities Education Act provides federal rights for eligible children with disabilities, including a free appropriate public education designed to meet their unique needs.
Part B generally covers eligible children and youth ages 3 through 21 under state implementation rules, while Part C addresses early intervention for eligible infants and toddlers.
An Individualized Education Program, or IEP, is the written education program used for an eligible child served under IDEA Part B.
Eligibility under IDEA is not automatic from a medical diagnosis alone; the child must meet applicable disability and educational-need requirements.
